name: Cascavel

queries.query: Cascavel Brazil official cadastral map parcels municipality geospatial
queries.result: Official results found the municipal GeoCascavel portal, IPC urban-map download, and a Paraná ArcGIS municipal cartographic service. No anonymous parcel-polygon response was established.

queries.query: Cascavel PR cadastro técnico multifinalitário mapa parcelário prefeitura
queries.result: Official Portuguese-language results identify GeoCascavel as the municipal cadastral map portal and IPC instructions for locating lots and generating a Consulta Prévia. No public anonymous ID-plus-parcel-geometry endpoint was exposed in the inspected responses.

registryBasis: The official Cascavel municipality/IPC pages identify GeoCascavel as the municipal cadastral map system and describe lot lookup and municipal parcel procedures. This evidences a local municipal cadastral custodian, not an open parcel-geometry API.

requests.outcome: Municipal GeoCascavel portal returned HTML and was reachable on retry; anonymous page inspection showed dashboard/cadastral references but no bounded parcel feature schema or ID-plus-geometry response. An earlier request timed out during DNS resolution and was not treated as absence evidence.
Official Paraná ArcGIS group layer for Cascavel returned extent and sublayers in EPSG:31982; sublayers are cartographic text/line and orthophoto, with no parcel polygon layer.
Layer schema identifies Cascavel [2021_05] (esc2000) - Linha as esriGeometryPolyline in EPSG:31982; it is not parcel geometry and was not queried for unsafe attributes.
Official search result confirms a municipal urban-map download page; no parcel API/schema was inferred from the search listing.
